_comment: Example only. Copy to template_map.json next to your real template and replace every reference with values from that template's profile (profile_template.py prints them). This file is what lets a proposal plan written in the canonical vocabulary build onto a template that names everything differently — without rewriting the plan.
_layout_aliases_note: Canonical layout id -> the layout in YOUR template. Only needed where normalised matching fails: build_deck.py already matches 'title-slide' to a layout named 'Title Slide' on its own. List the ones that genuinely differ.
_placeholder_aliases_note: Canonical placeholder -> the placeholder on YOUR layout, which may be a name or an idx. '*' applies to every layout; a layout name scopes an alias to that layout only, and wins over '*'.
_sections_note: Advisory, for Stage 2: which layout each section should normally use. Not enforced by the scripts.

cover.notes: Client legal name, RFP reference, date

understanding.notes: Their drivers left, our read right

team.notes: Delete unused member groups entirely — image and text boxes both

rules._vary_layouts_note: Never run more than two consecutive slides on the same layout — mapped sections spanning 3+ slides should alternate.
rules._respect_theme_fonts_note: Inherit fonts and colours from the template theme. render_pptx.py sets neither on a slide, and qa_pptx.py fails the deck if any slide does — that is how a deck silently drifts off-template.
